events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: It's a big birthday for one of Britain's most beloved comedy icons! John Cleese is 87 today. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incredible Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', originally released on December 3, 1965, celebrates its 61st anniversary.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed everything. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who was born in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: January 8th marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic English singer-songwriter and actor David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Celebrating Bowie
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true chameleon of rock whose influence is still felt everywhere. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: January 8th marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who was born in 1935.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, King
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still influencing generations! What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind behind some of rock's most iconic riffs. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop singer-songwriter Rod Stewart, known for hits like 'Maggie May' and 'Sailing', celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Rod Stewart turns 82 today! A career spanning decades and countless hits. What's your go-to Rod Stewart singalong?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legend that is Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing us 'One Step Beyond'. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for his 80s hits including 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Come Back and Stay', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the soulful voice of Paul Young! The 80s wouldn't have been the same without him. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music icon, singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, record producer, actress, author, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music, fashion, and philanthropy. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter, record producer, and television personality Gary Barlow, best known as the frontman of Take That, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Leader's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to musical theatre maestro. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B international hits in the 1970s and 1980s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' because it's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! What's your favourite soulful hit from this legend?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Always bringing the harmonies and the charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?
